_note: Coupled-inductor transformer (bw-board E3.4, spec-updates/coupled-inductors.md). Dots at p1/s1. params: {l1,l2,k} in henries, or {ratio, lm, k} (turns ratio + magnetizing inductance; defaults lm=10, k=0.999). k must sit in (0,1) — k=1 is refused at validation. Lossless windings; DC passes each winding as a short with no coupling, exactly like the silicon-free physics.
